name: about-sass
title: About SaaS Company
description: A light about page: a white card with a bold developer-focused headline and integration names, a stat pair beside a dark health chart, and three feature cards beneath.
use: A developer platform needs an about block pairing a statement with proof stats and a health chart.
avoid: Chart bar heights are hardcoded and the integration list is a fixed set of names.
a11y: The bar chart is built from divs with no text summary, so its values are invisible to screen readers. (keyboard: n-a, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A pale grey page holding a white rounded card with a faint watermark, a tiny uppercase label with a dot, and a very large bold two-line headline. Below, a short stat row sits left of a black rounded panel with six blue bars under a System Health caption.
behaves: Blocks fade up as they scroll into view, and the blue bars in the dark panel grow from nothing to their heights. A pulsing Optimal caption sits above the bars.
customise: Feature copy, integration names and bar heights sit in arrays in the file; colours and spacing are classes.
weight: light: A few fade-ups and six bars animating once; nothing loops except a pulse.
demo: Headline 'Built by developers, for the future of SaaS.', integrations GitHub, Vercel and AWS, plus 99.99% Uptime SLA.
issues: The bar chart carries no labels or text alternative for the values it shows.
The section is taller than one screen, so no frame shows the feature cards whole.
polishWhy: Confident type and a convincing health panel; the bottom cards are cut in every frame.
